subject: alt-c-pg
title: ALT.C.PG.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 232 (WAC-30). ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From ALT-F: EXP-DYM (expansion dynamics). From EXP-DYM: RT-DY (reality dynamics) and TR (transformation). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is on a dotted line from EXP-DYM. From TR: PROG-EXT-FT (progressional extended functionalism). TH-CONT (thrust continuance) is on a dotted line from TR.
